summary: Chinese tech hardware shares tumbled as impressive quarterly results at some companies failed to offset persistent concerns over fundamentals and weak global AI sentiment.

title: Henderson Land: HK Home Market Resilient to High Rates
summary: Andrew Fung, CFO at Henderson Land, discusses the impact of higher interest rates on Hong Kong's property market. He also says rental yields are supporting the housing market in the financial hub. He speaks exclusively on "Bloomberg: The China Show." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Japan 2-Year Bond Sale Sees Firm Demand Before BOJ Decision
summary: Japan’s two-year government bond auction drew firm demand, as elevated yields attracted investors ahead of a Bank of Japan policy decision on Friday, where rates are widely expected to remain unchanged.

title: HK Dollar Peg Architect Says Narrower Band May Ease Speculation
summary: Narrowing the Hong Kong dollar’s trading band against the US greenback may enhance stability and reassure the public if such a move were ever implemented, according to John Greenwood, the economist dubbed the father of the city’s currency peg.

title: Prediction Markets Avoid Australia’s Tough Line on Gambling
summary: Australia’s corporate regulator has not received a single application from a prediction market provider to operate in the country, where such platforms would likely face gambling rather than financial regulations.

title: Anthropic’s IPO Plans Draw Skepticism From Australian CIOs
summary: Some Australian investment chiefs are expressing caution over the impending blockbuster initial public offering of Anthropic PBC, as the company brings a fresh artificial intelligence bet to the local market.

title: Fed's Warsh on Why He Watches Korea's Economy Closely
summary: Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh closely monitors South Korea's economy because he views its tech exports as vital "feedstocks" and a leading indicator for what is coming through the global supply chain, a point he highlighted while noting that a task force will deliver recommendations on the Fed's balance sheet early next year. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Biggest Pharmacy Chain in Malaysia Plans $565 Million Share Sale
summary: Malaysia’s biggest pharmacy chain Big Caring Group Bhd. is offering shares worth up to 2.3 billion ringgit ($565 million) in an initial public offering that’s poised to be the country’s second largest listing this year.

title: Gold Dips to Near $4,000 as Fed Holds Rates With Little Guidance
summary: Gold declined after the Federal Reserve kept borrowing costs steady and offered few clues on its next move, leaving open the prospect of a rate hike before year-end.

title: Iron Ore’s Drop Below $90 Tests High-Cost Supply as Losses Mount
summary: Iron ore’s fall below $90 a ton has pushed as much as 170 million tons of production into losses, but prices will need to remain depressed for longer before enough supply exits to tighten the market, according to UBS Group AG.

title: CLSA Analyst: Samsung Shares Fell on Lack of Buybacks
summary: Samsung shares slid due to a lack of new announcements of share buybacks, according to CLSA Head of North Asia Semiconductors Research Sanjeev Rana. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Indonesia’s Wealth Fund CIO Owns Stake in Sanctioned Brokerage

summary: High delivery ratio on debut points to sticky investor demand for the stock.

title: Philippines May Use More Tools to Stem Peso Slide, Analysts Say
summary: The Philippine peso’s nearly 8% slide against the dollar this year may prompt the central bank to deploy more tools to stabilize the currency, according to marketwatchers.

title: Shapoorji Seeks to Raise Up to $200 Million to Repay Debt
summary: Shapoorji Pallonji Group is looking to raise $150 million to $200 million, according to people familiar with the matter, as the Indian conglomerate faces mounting debt obligations.
